- [NumberParam()](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/experiments/storage/functions/NumberParam.md): Experimental helper that creates a query-param config serializing numbers, optionally to a fixed precision, with an optional default value.
- [onStorageEvent()](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/experiments/storage/functions/onStorageEvent.md): Experimental helper that subscribes to storage changes from both native `StorageEvent`s and `CacheStorage` notifications, returning an unsubscribe function.
- [param()](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/experiments/storage/functions/param.md): Experimental decorator that marks a storage resource field as a URL query parameter, recording how to serialize it for a router integration.
- [SessionResource()](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/experiments/storage/functions/SessionResource.md): Experimental class decorator that turns a class into a reactive resource whose fields persist in sessionStorage.

##### /worker-fetch

###### exports

- [WorkerFetch](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/experiments/worker-fetch/classes/WorkerFetch.md)

#### @warp-drive/ember

- [@warp-drive/ember/experiments](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/ember/experiments.md): Experimental Ember components, `Paginate` and `EachLink`, for rendering reactive paginated collections built on `@warp-drive/experiments/pagination`.
- [@warp-drive/ember/install](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/ember/install.md): The `buildSignalConfig` function, which creates the signal hooks that wire WarpDrive reactivity into Ember autotracking using `@glimmer/validator` tags.

##### exports

- [<Await />](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/ember/classes/Await.md): Component that renders a pending, error or success block for the state of a promise or awaitable.
- [Request](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/ember/classes/Request.md): Component that monitors a request and renders a block for its idle, loading, error, cancelled or content state, with controls to retry, refresh or reload it.
- [Throw](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/ember/classes/Throw.md): Component that throws its `@error` argument when rendered, for templates that should fail if they reach that point.

##### /experiments

###### exports

- [<EachLink />](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/ember/experiments/classes/EachLink.md): Renderless component that yields the numbered, previous, next, first and last navigation links for a `<Paginate />` collection.
- [<Paginate />](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/ember/experiments/classes/Paginate.md): Component that monitors the request for a paginated collection and yields its pages, in paged or infinite mode, for navigating and rendering them.

##### /install

###### exports

- [buildSignalConfig()](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/ember/install/functions/buildSignalConfig.md): Creates the signal hooks that wire WarpDrive reactivity into Ember autotracking using `@glimmer/validator` tags.

#### @warp-drive/react

- [@warp-drive/react/install](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/react/install.md): Side-effect import that configures WarpDrive to use `@warp-drive/alien-signals` based reactivity, and registers React with it so its data updates re-render React components.

##### exports

- [WatcherContext](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/react/variables/WatcherContext.md): React context holding the signal watcher that the nearest `ReactiveContext` uses to track which WarpDrive signals its children read.
- [ReactiveContext()](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/react/functions/ReactiveContext.md): Component that re-renders its children when WarpDrive signals they read change, by providing a signal watcher through `WatcherContext`.
- [Request()](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/react/functions/Request.md): Component that renders idle, loading, error, cancelled, or content states for a request as it progresses, with retry and refresh support.
- [StoreProvider()](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/react/functions/StoreProvider.md): Component that provides a Store to its children, either the instance passed in or a new instance of the Store class passed in.
- [useStore()](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/react/functions/useStore.md): Hook that returns the Store provided by the nearest `StoreProvider`, asserting that one exists.

##### /install

###### exports

- [buildSignalConfig()](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/react/install/functions/buildSignalConfig.md): Builds the hooks that connect the `@warp-drive/alien-signals` graph to React rendering and test waiters.
- [settled()](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/react/install/functions/settled.md): Resolves once all requests tracked by the React signal integration have settled, for use in tests; a no-op unless `TESTING` is enabled.

#### @warp-drive/tc39-proposal-signals

- [@warp-drive/tc39-proposal-signals/install](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/tc39-proposal-signals/install.md): Side-effect import that configures WarpDrive to use the TC39 Signals polyfill, `signal-polyfill`, for reactivity.

##### /install

###### exports

- [buildSignalConfig()](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/tc39-proposal-signals/install/functions/buildSignalConfig.md): Builds the signal hooks that back WarpDrive reactivity with `Signal.State` and `Signal.Computed` from the TC39 Signals polyfill.

#### @warp-drive/alien-signals

- [@warp-drive/alien-signals/install](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/alien-signals/install.md): Side-effect import that configures WarpDrive to use a signals graph built on alien-signals for reactivity, which other frameworks' signals register with.
- [@warp-drive/alien-signals/primitives](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/alien-signals/primitives.md): Signals, memos and a watcher, built on alien-signals, that back WarpDrive reactivity and let framework integrations observe it.

##### /install

###### exports

- [buildSignalConfig()](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/alien-signals/install/functions/buildSignalConfig.md): Builds the signal hooks that back WarpDrive reactivity with signals and memos built on alien-signals, and that other signals implementations register with.
- [registerSignalIntegration()](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/alien-signals/install/functions/registerSignalIntegration.md): Adds a signals implementation or framework integration to the alien-signals graph.

##### /primitives

###### exports

- [Watcher](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/alien-signals/primitives/classes/Watcher.md): Observes signals and memos, calling back once when any of them may have changed until it is re-armed.
- [consumeSignal()](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/alien-signals/primitives/functions/consumeSignal.md): Makes the running memo depend on a signal; a no-op outside of a memo.
- [createMemo()](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/alien-signals/primitives/functions/createMemo.md): Creates a memo that caches a function's result, or its error, until a signal or memo it read changes.
- [createSignal()](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/alien-signals/primitives/functions/createSignal.md): Creates a value-less signal that memos and watchers can depend on and that `notifySignal` marks as changed.
- [hasSubscribers()](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/alien-signals/primitives/functions/hasSubscribers.md): Whether any memo or watcher depends on a signal or memo.
- [isTracking()](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/alien-signals/primitives/functions/isTracking.md): Whether a memo is computing, so that signals read now become its dependencies.
- [notifySignal()](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/alien-signals/primitives/functions/notifySignal.md): Marks everything that depends on a signal as changed and notifies the watchers that observe it.
- [readMemo()](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/alien-signals/primitives/functions/readMemo.md): Returns a memo's current result, recomputing it only when something it read changed.

#### @warp-drive/holodeck

- [@warp-drive/holodeck/mock](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/holodeck/mock.md): Helpers `GET`, `POST`, `PUT`, `PATCH`, `DELETE` and `HEAD` that register a mocked request and its response with the Holodeck test server, plus the scaffold types they accept.

##### exports

- [MockServerHandler](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/holodeck/classes/MockServerHandler.md): RequestManager handler that routes requests to the Holodeck mock server by tagging each url with the test id and request count.
- [getIsRecording()](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/holodeck/functions/getIsRecording.md): Reports whether Holodeck mocks are recorded to fixtures, using the `setIsRecording` override when set or the build-time `SHOULD_RECORD` flag otherwise.
- [installAdapterFor()](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/holodeck/functions/installAdapterFor.md): Patches a legacy store so its adapters send `_fetchRequest` calls through the Holodeck mock server for the given test context.
- [mock()](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/holodeck/functions/mock.md): Registers a mock response with the Holodeck server for the current test, recording it as a fixture when recording and only counting it when replaying.
- [setConfig()](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/holodeck/functions/setConfig.md): Sets the host url of the Holodeck mock server that recordings are sent to.
- [setIsRecording()](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/holodeck/functions/setIsRecording.md): Overrides at runtime whether Holodeck mocks are recorded to fixtures, in place of the build-time `SHOULD_RECORD` flag.
- [setTestId()](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/holodeck/functions/setTestId.md): Assigns a test context its Holodeck test id before a test, or clears it after, reporting an error for any mock the test never requested.

##### /mock

###### exports

- [DELETE()](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/holodeck/mock/functions/DELETE.md): Mocks a DELETE request to a url on the Holodeck server, returning a generated response with a 200 status, or 204 when it has no body.
- [GET()](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/holodeck/mock/functions/GET.md): Mocks a GET request to a url on the Holodeck server, returning a generated response with a default 200 status.
- [HEAD()](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/holodeck/mock/functions/HEAD.md): Mocks a HEAD request to a url on the Holodeck server, returning a generated response with a default 200 status.
- [PATCH()](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/holodeck/mock/functions/PATCH.md): Mocks a PATCH request to a url on the Holodeck server, returning a generated response with a 200 status, or 204 when it has no body.
- [POST()](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/holodeck/mock/functions/POST.md): Mocks a POST request to a url on the Holodeck server, returning a generated response with a 201 status, or 204 when it has no body.
- [PUT()](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/holodeck/mock/functions/PUT.md): Mocks a PUT request to a url on the Holodeck server, returning a generated response with a 200 status, or 204 when it has no body.

#### @warp-drive/schema-dsl

##### /Entity Decorators

- [ObjectSchema()](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/schema-dsl/functions/ObjectSchema.md): Class decorator that compiles a class into an object schema for embedded, identity-less data used as the value of `schemaObject` and `schemaArray` fields.
- [Resource()](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/schema-dsl/functions/Resource.md): Class decorator that compiles a class into a resource schema, with a type derived from the class name and one field per decorated property.
- [trait()](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/schema-dsl/functions/trait.md): Class decorator that records which traits a schema-dsl resource or trait composes, compiling their names into its `traits` array without merging their fields.
- [Trait()](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/schema-dsl/functions/Trait-1.md): Class decorator that compiles a class into a trait, a reusable set of fields that resources and other traits can compose via `@trait`.

##### /Field Decorators

- [alias()](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/schema-dsl/functions/alias.md): Property decorator that compiles to an alias field, which reads from another field in the same schema and can write back to it in editable modes.
- [array()](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/schema-dsl/functions/array.md): Property decorator that compiles to an array field holding primitive values; use `schemaArray` for arrays of structured objects.
- [attribute()](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/schema-dsl/functions/attribute.md): LEGACY property decorator that compiles to an attribute field for `@warp-drive/legacy/model` resources; prefer `field` for new schemas.
- [belongsTo()](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/schema-dsl/functions/belongsTo.md): LEGACY property decorator that compiles to a belongsTo relationship field, valid only on resources declared with `@Resource({ legacy: true })`.
- [createonly()](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/schema-dsl/functions/createonly.md): Reserved property decorator for marking a field create-only in future generated types; currently a no-op with no effect on the compiled schema.
- [derived()](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/schema-dsl/functions/derived.md): Property decorator that compiles to a derived field, a read-only value computed by a registered derivation and never cached or sent to the server.
- [editonly()](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/schema-dsl/functions/editonly.md): Reserved property decorator for marking a field edit-only in future generated types; currently a no-op with no effect on the compiled schema.
- [field()](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/schema-dsl/functions/field.md): Property decorator that compiles to a generic field holding a primitive value, usable on resources, object schemas, and traits.
- [hash()](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/schema-dsl/functions/hash.md): Property decorator that compiles to the hash field an object schema uses as its identity, computed by a registered hash function.
- [hasMany()](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/schema-dsl/functions/hasMany.md): LEGACY property decorator that compiles to a hasMany relationship field, valid only on resources declared with `@Resource({ legacy: true })`.
- [id()](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/schema-dsl/functions/id.md): Property decorator that makes the decorated property a resource's identity field, needed only when the primary key is not named `id`.
- [local()](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/schema-dsl/functions/local.md): Property decorator that compiles to a local field, instance-only state that is never read from or written to the cache or sent to the server.
- [object()](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/schema-dsl/functions/object.md): Property decorator that compiles to an object field, a map of primitive values with no defined shape; use `schemaObject` for shaped objects.
- [optional()](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/schema-dsl/functions/optional.md): Reserved property decorator for marking a field optional in future generated create types; currently a no-op with no effect on the compiled schema.
- [readonly()](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/schema-dsl/functions/readonly.md): Reserved property decorator for marking a field read-only in future generated types; currently a no-op with no effect on the compiled schema.
- [schemaArray()](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/schema-dsl/functions/schemaArray.md): Property decorator that compiles to a schema-array field, an inline array of embedded objects whose shape is defined by an object schema.
- [schemaObject()](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/@warp-drive/schema-dsl/functions/schemaObject.md): Property decorator that compiles to a schema-object field, an inline embedded object whose shape is defined by an object schema.

#### eslint-plugin-warp-drive

- [eslint-plugin-warp-drive/recommended](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/eslint-plugin-warp-drive/recommended.md): Flat ESLint config that registers the `warp-drive` plugin and turns on its recommended rules as errors.

##### exports

- [export=](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/eslint-plugin-warp-drive/variables/export=.md)

##### /recommended

###### exports

- [export=](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/eslint-plugin-warp-drive/recommended/variables/export=.md): Flat ESLint config array that registers the `warp-drive` plugin and turns on its recommended set of rules as errors.

##### /rules

- [eslint-plugin-warp-drive/rules/no-create-record-rerender](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/eslint-plugin-warp-drive/rules/no-create-record-rerender.md): Lint rule that disallows `store.createRecord` in getters, constructors, class properties, and component lifecycle hooks, where it can cause re-render issues.
- [eslint-plugin-warp-drive/rules/no-external-request-patterns](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/eslint-plugin-warp-drive/rules/no-external-request-patterns.md): Lint rule that disallows `fetch`, jQuery, ajax-service, and `XMLHttpRequest` requests in favor of `store.request()`.
- [eslint-plugin-warp-drive/rules/no-invalid-relationships](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/eslint-plugin-warp-drive/rules/no-invalid-relationships.md): Lint rule that requires `@belongsTo` and `@hasMany` decorators to specify a boolean `async` and an `inverse`.
- [eslint-plugin-warp-drive/rules/no-invalid-resource-ids](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/eslint-plugin-warp-drive/rules/no-invalid-resource-ids.md): Lint rule, with autofix, that requires resource IDs passed to store methods and request builders to be strings.
- [eslint-plugin-warp-drive/rules/no-invalid-resource-types](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/eslint-plugin-warp-drive/rules/no-invalid-resource-types.md): Lint rule, with autofix, that enforces a configurable naming convention for resource types, defaulting to singular dasherized.
- [eslint-plugin-warp-drive/rules/no-legacy-imports](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/eslint-plugin-warp-drive/rules/no-legacy-imports.md): Lint rule, with autofix, that rewrites imports from legacy EmberData module paths to their modern replacements.
- [eslint-plugin-warp-drive/rules/no-legacy-request-patterns](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/eslint-plugin-warp-drive/rules/no-legacy-request-patterns.md): Lint rule that disallows legacy store and model request methods such as `findRecord`, `query`, and `save` in favor of `store.request()`.
- [eslint-plugin-warp-drive/rules/no-test-module-hooks](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/eslint-plugin-warp-drive/rules/no-test-module-hooks.md): Lint rule that disallows `hooks.beforeEach` and `hooks.afterEach` in tests in favor of setup functions each test calls explicitly.
- [eslint-plugin-warp-drive/rules/require-request-error-block](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/eslint-plugin-warp-drive/rules/require-request-error-block.md): Lint rule that requires every React `<Request>` component to be given a `states.error` handler.
- [eslint-plugin-warp-drive/rules/template-always-use-request-content](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/eslint-plugin-warp-drive/rules/template-always-use-request-content.md): Lint rule that requires a `<Request>` component's `:content` block to capture and use the yielded request result.
- [eslint-plugin-warp-drive/rules/template-require-request-error-block](https://canary.warp-drive.io/api/eslint-plugin-warp-drive/rules/template-require-request-error-block.md): Lint rule that requires `<Request>` and `<Await>` components to provide an `:error` block so rejections do not crash the app.
