### Other

- [AddResourceOperation](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/cache/operations/types/AddResourceOperation.md): Cache operation passed to `cache.patch` that adds a persisted resource's data to the cache's remote state.
- [AddToDocumentOperation](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/cache/operations/types/AddToDocumentOperation.md): Cache operation passed to `cache.patch` that adds resources to a request document's `data` or `included`, optionally at an index.
- [AddToResourceRelationshipMutation](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/cache/mutations/types/AddToResourceRelationshipMutation.md): Cache mutation passed to `cache.mutate` that adds one or more resources to a relationship's local state, optionally at an index.
- [AddToResourceRelationshipOperation](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/cache/operations/types/AddToResourceRelationshipOperation.md): Cache operation passed to `cache.patch` that adds resources to a relationship's remote state, optionally at an index.
- [AliasOptions](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/schema-dsl/types/AliasOptions.md): Options for the `@alias` decorator that identify the existing field (its kind, name, transformation type, and sourceKey) the alias points to.
- [ApiError](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/spec/error/types/ApiError.md): One {json:api} error object, with optional `status`, `code`, `title`, `detail`, `source`, `links`, and `meta`, found in a document's `errors` array.
- [ArrayField](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/schema/fields/types/ArrayField.md): Field schema of kind `array` for an array of primitive values, each optionally passed through a registered transformation.
- [ArrayFieldOptions](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/schema-dsl/types/ArrayFieldOptions.md): Options for the `@array` decorator that set the compiled array field's `sourceKey` and the transformation applied to each item.
- [ArrayValue](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/json/raw/types/ArrayValue.md): A JSON array whose members are all JSON values.
- [AttributeOptions](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/schema-dsl/types/AttributeOptions.md): Options for the legacy `@attribute` decorator that set the compiled attribute field's `sourceKey` and legacy transform `type`.
- [AttributesSchema](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/schema/schema-service/types/AttributesSchema.md): Legacy attribute field definitions keyed by attribute name, returned by the deprecated `attributesDefinitionFor` schema hook.
- [AttrOptions](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/schema/fields/types/AttrOptions.md): Options object on a legacy `attribute` field schema, holding a `defaultValue` (a primitive or a function producing one) plus any transform-specific options.
- [Autogeneration Notice](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/public/logos/synced/README.md)
- [AutorefreshBehaviorCombos](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/reactive/types/AutorefreshBehaviorCombos.md): The accepted values for a request subscription's `autorefresh` option: a boolean or a comma-separated mix of `online`, `interval`, and `invalid`.
- [AutorefreshBehaviorType](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/reactive/types/AutorefreshBehaviorType.md): One autorefresh trigger for a request subscription: on reconnecting (`online`), on a timer (`interval`), or on store invalidation (`invalid`).
- [Awaitable](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/request/types/Awaitable.md): Any promise-like value with `then`, `catch`, and `finally`, as accepted by the promise-result cache and `getPromiseState`.
- [BaseFinderOptions](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/types/BaseFinderOptions.md): Legacy reload, background-reload, include, and adapterOptions settings shared by `store.findRecord` and `store.findAll`.
- [BelongsToOptions](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/schema-dsl/types/BelongsToOptions.md): Options for the legacy `@belongsTo` decorator that describe the related type, inverse, async and polymorphic behavior, and `sourceKey`.
- [BuildURLConfig](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/utilities/types/BuildURLConfig.md): The global `host` and `namespace` that `buildBaseURL` prefixes onto URLs when a call does not pass its own.
- [Cache](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/cache/types/Cache.md): Contract a Cache implementation fulfills to store, patch, mutate, and read document and resource data for the Store, including local changes, errors, and SSR hydration.
- [CacheableFieldSchema](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/schema/fields/types/CacheableFieldSchema.md): Union of the field schemas whose values live in the cache, excluding alias, local, and derived fields.
- [CacheCapabilitiesManager](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/types/CacheCapabilitiesManager.md): The narrow slice of Store API handed to a Cache via `createCache`, for key lookup, schema access, record id updates, and change notifications.
- [CacheControlValue](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/store/types/CacheControlValue.md): The directives of a `Cache-Control` header as an object of flags and second counts, as returned by `parseCacheControl`.
- [CacheHandler](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/request/types/CacheHandler.md): The single handler a RequestManager runs before all others via `useCache`, which may return a result synchronously.
- [CacheKeyType](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/identifier/types/CacheKeyType.md): Which cache bucket a key belongs to: `'record'` for resource keys or `'document'` for request keys.
- [CacheOperation](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/CacheOperation.md): The lifecycle notification kinds sent to resource subscribers: `added`, `removed`, `updated`, or `state`.
- [CacheOptions](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/request/types/CacheOptions.md): Per-request settings on `cacheOptions` that control the cache key, forced or background reloads, invalidation by resource type, and cache bypass.
- [CachePolicy](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/CachePolicy.md): The interface a store's `lifetimes` service implements to decide when cached requests are hard or soft expired and should be refetched.
- [CacheStorageEvent](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/experiments/storage/types/CacheStorageEvent.md)
- [CancelledRequest](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/reactive/types/CancelledRequest.md)
- [CAUTION_MEGA_DANGER_ZONE_Extension](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/reactive/types/CAUTION_MEGA_DANGER_ZONE_Extension.md): Registers named methods, getters, and values to add to ReactiveResources, ReactiveObjects, or ReactiveArrays; meant only as a temporary aid when migrating from Model or ModelFragments.
- [Change](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/cache/change/types/Change.md): One upsert or removal of a resource or document recorded by the cache, with an optional patch, as returned by `cache.diff`.
- [ChangedAttributesHash](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/cache/types/ChangedAttributesHash.md): Map of attribute name to `[oldValue, newValue]` for a resource's uncommitted attribute changes, as returned by `cache.changedAttrs`.
- [ChromeComponentProps](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/react/types/ChromeComponentProps.md): The props the React `<Request />` component passes to its `chrome` component: the rendered state, the request state, and the content features.
- [CollectionField](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/schema/fields/types/CollectionField.md): Field schema of kind `collection` for a possibly paginated reference to other resources; not yet implemented by `ReactiveResource`.
- [CollectionRelationship](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/cache/relationship/types/CollectionRelationship.md): Cache-side state of a to-many relationship, with `data` as an array of `ResourceKey`s plus optional meta and pagination links.
- [CollectionResourceDataDocument](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/spec/document/types/CollectionResourceDataDocument.md): A raw {json:api} document whose `data` is an array of resources, as returned by a request and inserted into the cache.
- [CollectionResourceDocument](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/spec/json-api-raw/types/CollectionResourceDocument.md): A raw {json:api} document whose `data` is an array of existing resource objects, with optional `included`, `meta`, and `links`.
- [CollectionResourceRelationship](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/spec/json-api-raw/types/CollectionResourceRelationship.md): A to-many {json:api} relationship object whose `data` is an array of resource identifiers, with optional `meta` and pagination `links`.
- [ComposingSignalHooks](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/alien-signals/install/types/ComposingSignalHooks.md): The signal hooks backed by the alien-signals graph, which other signals implementations register with.
- [CompressionOptions](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/utilities/handlers/types/CompressionOptions.md): Options for `new AutoCompress()`: the compression format, size constraints and whether to stream the body.
- [ConstrainedRequestOptions](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/request/types/ConstrainedRequestOptions.md): Options the request builders accept to set reload behavior and override the url's host, namespace, resource path, and query param serialization.
- [Constraints](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/utilities/handlers/types/Constraints.md): Minimum request body sizes, per body type, at which `AutoCompress` compresses a body.
- [ContentFeatures](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/reactive/types/ContentFeatures.md): The online, visibility, and refreshing state plus `refresh`, `reload`, and `abort` functions a request subscription exposes alongside successful content.
- [Context](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/request/types/Context.md): The per-request object passed to each handler, exposing the immutable request plus methods to set the response, stream, and request key.
- [Contributors](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/contributors.md): See the WarpDrive core team and the full list of GitHub contributors whose work has shaped the project.
- [CreateRecordUrlOptions](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/utilities/types/CreateRecordUrlOptions.md): Options passed to `buildBaseURL` to build the collection URL a new record of a given type is saved to.
- [CreateRequestOptions](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/request/types/CreateRequestOptions.md): Shape of the `POST` request object that `createRecord` builders return for `store.request`, identifying the new resource being saved.
- [Deferred](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/request/types/Deferred.md): A promise bundled with the `resolve` and `reject` callbacks that settle it, as returned by `createDeferred`.
- [DeleteRecordOperation](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/graph/types/DeleteRecordOperation.md): Graph operation signaling that a resource was deleted so it is removed from every relationship that references it.
- [DeleteRecordUrlOptions](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/utilities/types/DeleteRecordUrlOptions.md): Options passed to `buildBaseURL` to build the URL for deleting an existing record by type and id.
- [DeleteRequestOptions](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/request/types/DeleteRequestOptions.md): Shape of the `DELETE` request object that `deleteRecord` builders return for `store.request`, identifying the resource being deleted.
- [Derivation](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/schema/concepts/types/Derivation.md): A registered function that computes a memoized, read-only field value from a record's other fields, backing `derived` fields.
- [DerivedField](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/schema/fields/types/DerivedField.md): Field schema of kind `derived` for a read-only, memoized value computed by a registered derivation and never cached or sent to the server.
- [DerivedOptions](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/schema-dsl/types/DerivedOptions.md): Options for the `@derived` decorator that name the registered derivation that computes the field and the options passed to it.
- [Document](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/Document.md): Deprecated alias for `ReactiveDocument`, the reactive wrapper around a request's response document.
- [DocumentCacheOperation](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/DocumentCacheOperation.md): The notification kinds sent to request document subscribers, such as `updated` or `invalidated`.
- [EffectStorageEvent](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/experiments/storage/types/EffectStorageEvent.md)
- [EmberRequestArgs](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/ember/types/EmberRequestArgs.md): The args of the Ember `<Request />` component: the request or query to run, store, subscription, autorefresh options, and chrome.
- [EmptyResourceDocument](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/spec/json-api-raw/types/EmptyResourceDocument.md): A raw {json:api} document whose `data` is `null`, such as the response to a `DELETE` request.
- [ExistingResourceObject](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/spec/json-api-raw/types/ExistingResourceObject.md): A raw {json:api} resource object for a persisted resource: `type` and `id` plus optional `lid`, `attributes`, `relationships`, `links`, and `meta`.
- [ExtensionDef](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/reactive/types/ExtensionDef.md): One normalized feature of a schema extension, tagged by kind as a method, a readonly or mutable value, or a getter/setter accessor.
- [ExtractSuggestedCacheTypes](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/record/types/ExtractSuggestedCacheTypes.md): Type utility giving the union of resource types reachable from a typed record through its relationships, up to a max depth.
- [FetchError](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/request/types/FetchError.md): The shape of errors thrown by the Fetch handler for failed, aborted, or network-errored requests, carrying the HTTP `status` and `statusText`.
- [FieldOptions](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/schema-dsl/types/FieldOptions.md): Options for the `@field` decorator that set the compiled field's transformation `type` and `sourceKey`.
- [FieldSchema](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/schema/fields/types/FieldSchema.md): Union of every LegacyMode and PolarisMode field schema; prefer the mode-specific unions for more precise type-checking.
- [FindAllOptions](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/types/FindAllOptions.md): Legacy reload, background-reload, include, and adapterOptions settings for `store.findAll`.
- [FindManyUrlOptions](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/utilities/types/FindManyUrlOptions.md): Options passed to `buildBaseURL` to build the URL for fetching several resources, pathed by the first identifier's type.
- [FindRecordOptions](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/request/types/FindRecordOptions.md): Options the `findRecord` request builders accept: the shared url and reload options plus the relationship paths to `include`.
- [FindRecordOptions](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/types/FindRecordOptions.md): Legacy options for `store.findRecord`, adding a discouraged `preload` of field values to the shared reload and adapter settings.
- [FindRecordRequestOptions](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/request/types/FindRecordRequestOptions.md): Shape of the `GET` request object that `findRecord` builders return for `store.request`, carrying the url, headers, and requested resource identifier.
- [FindRecordUrlOptions](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/utilities/types/FindRecordUrlOptions.md): Options passed to `buildBaseURL` to build the URL for fetching one resource by type and id.
- [FindRelatedCollectionUrlOptions](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/utilities/types/FindRelatedCollectionUrlOptions.md): Options passed to `buildBaseURL` to build the URL for a record's has-many relationship, ending in the field name.
- [FindRelatedResourceUrlOptions](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/utilities/types/FindRelatedResourceUrlOptions.md): Options passed to `buildBaseURL` to build the URL for a record's belongs-to relationship, ending in the field name.
- [Future](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/request/types/Future.md): The promise returned for every request, resolving with the response document and able to abort the request or expose its response stream early.
- [GenericField](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/schema/fields/types/GenericField.md): Field schema of kind `field` for a primitive value, optionally converted by a registered `Transformation`; objects and arrays in it are not deep-tracked.
- [GenericUrlOptions](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/utilities/types/GenericUrlOptions.md): Options passed to `buildBaseURL` to build a URL from an explicit `resourcePath` with no request `op`.
- [Handler](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/request/types/Handler.md): An object with a `request` method that a RequestManager calls to fulfill a request, either itself or by calling `next` to pass it along.
- [HashField](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/schema/fields/types/HashField.md): Field schema of kind `@hash` that computes a schema-object's identity from its cache data using a registered hash function.
- [HashFn](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/schema/concepts/types/HashFn.md): A registered function that computes a stable string identity from an object's cache data, used for `@hash` fields and polymorphic schema-object types.
- [HashOptions](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/schema-dsl/types/HashOptions.md): Options for the `@hash` decorator that name the registered hash function used to compute an object schema's identity.
- [HasManyOptions](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/schema-dsl/types/HasManyOptions.md): Options for the legacy `@hasMany` decorator that describe the related type, inverse, async and polymorphic behavior, and `sourceKey`.
- [HooksOptions](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/configure/types/HooksOptions.md): The options passed to the `setupSignals` callback, including the well-known key WarpDrive uses for an array's contents signal.
- [HTTPMethod](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/request/types/HTTPMethod.md): Union of the HTTP method strings, including `QUERY`, that a WarpDrive request's `method` may be set to.
- [IdentityField](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/schema/fields/types/IdentityField.md): Field schema of kind `@id` naming which field holds a resource's primary key, with an optional `sourceKey` when the API uses another name like `uuid`.
- [IdOptions](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/schema-dsl/types/IdOptions.md): Options for the `@id` decorator that set the compiled identity field's `sourceKey`.
- [ImmutableCreateRequestOptions](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/request/types/ImmutableCreateRequestOptions.md): Read-only view of a `createRecord` request as a handler receives it, with immutable headers and `records` as resource keys.
- [ImmutableDeleteRequestOptions](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/request/types/ImmutableDeleteRequestOptions.md): Read-only view of a `deleteRecord` request as a handler receives it, with immutable headers and `records` as resource keys.
- [ImmutableHeaders](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/request/types/ImmutableHeaders.md): Read-only `Headers` that handlers see on a request, adding `toJSON` to serialize them as `[key, value]` pairs and an optional mutable `clone`.
- [ImmutableRequestInfo](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/request/types/ImmutableRequestInfo.md): Read-only form of a request as handlers receive it, with frozen headers, data, options, and cache options and no `controller`.
- [ImmutableUpdateRequestOptions](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/request/types/ImmutableUpdateRequestOptions.md): Read-only view of an `updateRecord` request as a handler receives it, with immutable headers and `records` as resource keys.
- [Includes](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/record/types/Includes.md): Type utility giving the union of valid dot-separated `include` relationship paths for a typed record, excluding cycles.
- [InfinitePaginationContentFeatures](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/experiments/pagination/types/InfinitePaginationContentFeatures.md): Experimental: the request controls `<Paginate />` yields to its content block in infinite mode, adding `loadNext` and `loadPrev` to extend the loaded pages.
- [InfinitePaginationState](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/experiments/pagination/types/InfinitePaginationState.md): Experimental: the pagination state `<Paginate />` yields in infinite mode, exposing the accumulated items and pages plus `loadNext` and `loadPrev` to extend them.
- [InnerRelationshipDocument](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/spec/json-api-raw/types/InnerRelationshipDocument.md): A single {json:api} relationship object, either to-one or to-many, as found in a resource's `relationships` member.
- [InternalCacheStorageEvent](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/experiments/storage/types/InternalCacheStorageEvent.md)
- [JSONAPIConfig](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/utilities/json-api/types/JSONAPIConfig.md): Configuration for the JSON:API request builders: host, namespace, and the profile and extension URIs for `Accept`.
- [JsonApiResourcePatch](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/utilities/json-api/types/JsonApiResourcePatch.md): A JSON:API resource object holding only a record's changed attributes and relationships, as produced by `serializePatch`.
- [KeyFn](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/experiments/storage/types/KeyFn.md): Experimental function type that derives a unique storage key from a storage resource instance, so each instance persists its own data.
- [LazyScaffold](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/holodeck/mock/types/LazyScaffold.md): Mock whose method and url are known up front and whose full scaffold is built only when recording, as passed by the Holodeck mock helpers to `mock`.
- [LegacyAliasField](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/schema/fields/types/LegacyAliasField.md): Field schema of kind `alias` for LegacyMode resources that exposes another field's cache value, including legacy attributes and relationships, under a new name.
- [LegacyAttributeField](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/schema/fields/types/LegacyAttributeField.md): Legacy field schema of kind `attribute` for a primitive value whose `type` names a legacy transform a serializer may apply; LegacyMode only.
- [LegacyBelongsToField](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/schema/fields/types/LegacyBelongsToField.md): Legacy field schema of kind `belongsTo` for a reference to one related resource, with required `async` and `inverse` options and optional `linksMode`.
- [LegacyField](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/schema/fields/types/LegacyField.md): Union of the legacy attribute, belongsTo, and hasMany field schemas, including the LinksMode relationship variants.
- [LegacyHasManyField](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/schema/fields/types/LegacyHasManyField.md): Legacy field schema of kind `hasMany` for a reference to many related resources, with required `async` and `inverse` options and optional `linksMode`.
- [LegacyLiveArray](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/reactive/types/LegacyLiveArray.md): Legacy reactive array of every record of one type in the store, returned by `store.peekAll` and `store.findAll`. we recommend againt using LiveArrays. Use Store.request instead
- [LegacyManyArray](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/reactive/types/LegacyManyArray.md): Legacy mutable reactive array holding the related records of a legacy or linksMode has-many relationship.
- [LegacyModeFieldSchema](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/schema/fields/types/LegacyModeFieldSchema.md): Union of every field schema allowed on a LegacyMode resource schema, including legacy attribute, belongsTo, and hasMany fields.
- [LegacyQueryArray](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/reactive/types/LegacyQueryArray.md): Legacy immutable reactive array of the primary records returned by `store.query`, refreshable with `update()` and released with `destroy()`. we recommend againt using QueryArrays. Use Store.request instead
- [LegacyRelationshipField](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/schema/fields/types/LegacyRelationshipField.md): Union of the legacy belongsTo and hasMany field schemas, including their LinksMode variants.
- [LegacyResourceQuery](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/types/LegacyResourceQuery.md): Legacy query object for `store.query` and `store.queryRecord` that the adapter turns into request query params, with an optional `include`.
- [LegacyResourceSchema](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/schema/fields/types/LegacyResourceSchema.md): Schema describing a LegacyMode resource type, marked `legacy: true`, with its identity field, fields, traits, and optional extensions.
- [LegacyTrait](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/schema/fields/types/LegacyTrait.md): A named, reusable set of LegacyMode fields that resource schemas compose in via their `traits`, often to model polymorphic capabilities.
- [Link](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/spec/json-api-raw/types/Link.md): A {json:api} link value, either a plain URI-reference string or an object with `href` and optional `meta`.
- [LinkObject](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/spec/json-api-raw/types/LinkObject.md): The object form of a {json:api} link: an `href` URI-reference plus optional `meta`.
- [Links](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/spec/json-api-raw/types/Links.md): The `links` member of a {json:api} resource, relationship, or document, with optional `self` and `related` links.
- [LinksModeBelongsToField](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/schema/fields/types/LinksModeBelongsToField.md): Legacy field schema of kind `belongsTo` in LinksMode: a sync reference to one related resource, loaded via links without adapters, usable in PolarisMode.
- [LinksModeHasManyField](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/schema/fields/types/LinksModeHasManyField.md): Legacy field schema of kind `hasMany` in LinksMode: a sync reference to many related resources, loaded via links without adapters, usable in PolarisMode.
- [LLM Optimized Documentation](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/llm-docs.md): Where to find llms.txt, llms-full.txt, their legacy counterparts, and the plain-Markdown twin of every page, and how the Copy page button uses them.
- [LocalField](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/schema/fields/types/LocalField.md): Field schema of kind `@local` for memoized, writable per-record state that is never cached or sent to the server; currently private to built-in fields.
- [LocalOptions](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/schema-dsl/types/LocalOptions.md): Options for the `@local` decorator that set the local field's value before it is first set.
- [LocalRelationshipOperation](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/graph/types/LocalRelationshipOperation.md): Union of the Graph operations that update a relationship's local (uncommitted) state.
- [ManagedRequestPriority](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/request/types/ManagedRequestPriority.md): Marks whether a deduped managed request blocks its caller's promise or runs as a non-blocking background reload.
- [Mask](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/record/types/Mask.md): Type utility that builds a preview type from `T` by replacing selected fields with narrower subset types from `K`, resolving to `never` where a field is not compatible.
- [MemoNode](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/alien-signals/primitives/types/MemoNode.md): The opaque node returned by `createMemo`, which caches a function's result until something it read changes.
- [MergeOperation](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/cache/operations/types/MergeOperation.md): Cache operation telling the Cache that two resource keys refer to the same resource, so it can merge the stale one into the kept one.
- [Meta](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/spec/json-api-raw/types/Meta.md): A JSON object of non-standard information found in the `meta` member of a {json:api} document, resource, relationship, or link.
- [ModelSchema](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/types/ModelSchema.md): Legacy shape of a Model class's static schema API (fields, attributes, relationships, iterators) used by the legacy schema service and Adapters/Serializers.
- [Mutable](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/utils/types/Mutable.md): Utility type that strips `readonly` from every property of an object type.
- [Mutation](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/cache/mutations/types/Mutation.md): Union of the relationship changes `cache.mutate` applies to local (uncommitted) state rather than remote state.
- [NewResourceKey](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/identifier/types/NewResourceKey.md): Resource key for a record created locally with `store.createRecord`, whose `id` may still be `null`.
- [NewResourceObject](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/spec/json-api-raw/types/NewResourceObject.md): A raw {json:api} resource object for a client-created resource not yet persisted, identified by `type` and `lid` with an `id` that may be `null`.
- [NextFn](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/request/types/NextFn.md): The function a request handler calls to pass a request to the next handler in the chain, returning a `Future` for its response.
- [NotificationChannel](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/NotificationChannel.md): Scopes an `attributes` or `relationships` notification to a resource's local (editable) or remote (persisted) view so only matching subscribers hear it.
- [NotificationManager](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/store/types/NotificationManager.md): The store service that lets code subscribe to and batch-deliver change notifications for cached resources and request documents.
- [NotificationType](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/NotificationType.md): Every notification kind a resource subscriber can receive, from lifecycle operations to `attributes`, `relationships`, `errors`, `meta`, and `identity` changes.
- [NotifyKeys](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/NotifyKeys.md): A set of field names passed to `notify` or `notifyChange` to report many `attributes` or `relationships` changes in one call.
- [ObjectAliasField](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/schema/fields/types/ObjectAliasField.md): Field schema of kind `alias` for object schemas that exposes another non-relationship field's cache value under a new name.
- [ObjectField](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/schema/fields/types/ObjectField.md): Field schema of kind `object` for a plain object of primitive values, optionally passed as a whole through a registered transformation.
- [ObjectFieldOptions](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/schema-dsl/types/ObjectFieldOptions.md): Options for the `@object` decorator that set the compiled object field's `sourceKey` and the transformation applied to the whole object.
- [ObjectFieldSchema](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/schema/fields/types/ObjectFieldSchema.md): Union of the field schemas allowed in an `ObjectSchema`, which excludes identity and relationship fields.
- [ObjectSchema](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/schema/fields/types/ObjectSchema.md): Schema describing an embedded object that has no identity of its own, used by `schema-object` and `schema-array` fields.
- [ObjectSchemaOptions](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/schema-dsl/types/ObjectSchemaOptions.md): Options for the `ObjectSchema` class decorator; currently only a reserved `hash` flag that has no effect on the compiled object schema.
- [ObjectValue](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/json/raw/types/ObjectValue.md): A plain JSON object whose property values are all JSON values.
- [Op](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/cache/operations/types/Op.md): Base shape of every cache operation, carrying the operation's name in `op`.
- [OpaqueRecordInstance](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/record/types/OpaqueRecordInstance.md): Type-erased (`unknown`) stand-in for a record instance where its specific type is unknown or irrelevant.
- [Operation](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/cache/operations/types/Operation.md): Union of the updates `cache.patch` applies to the cache's remote (clean) state, typically from server pushes such as WebSocket or SSE messages.
- [Operation](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/graph/types/Operation.md): Base shape of every relationship Graph operation, carrying the operation's name in `op`.
- [PageCache](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/experiments/pagination/types/PageCache.md): Experimental: one page of a paginated collection, exposing its request, loading and error status, data, and links to neighboring pages.
- [PagedPaginationContentFeatures](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/experiments/pagination/types/PagedPaginationContentFeatures.md): Experimental: the request controls `<Paginate />` yields to its content block in paged mode, adding `loadPage` to navigate to a page by URL.
- [PagedPaginationState](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/experiments/pagination/types/PagedPaginationState.md): Experimental: the pagination state `<Paginate />` yields in paged mode, exposing the active page, its request, and `loadPage` for navigating to a page by URL.
- [PageHints](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/experiments/pagination/types/PageHints.md): Experimental: a function you pass to `<Paginate />` that reads `currentPage` and `totalPages` from a loaded document when they are not in the default `meta` locations.
- [PaginateArgs](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/experiments/pagination/types/PaginateArgs.md)
- [PaginateMode](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/experiments/pagination/types/PaginateMode.md): Experimental: the `@mode` value of `<Paginate />`, either `'paged'` for a single-page view or `'infinite'` for an accumulated view, which selects the yielded pagination API.
- [PaginationCache](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/experiments/pagination/types/PaginationCache.md): Experimental: the shared, app-wide store of loaded pages, page order, and `totalPages` for one paginated collection, keyed by its `first` or `self` link.
- [PaginationContentFeatures](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/experiments/pagination/types/PaginationContentFeatures.md): Experimental: the combined paged and infinite content features a pagination subscription builds, before `<Paginate />` narrows them to one mode.
- [PaginationContentFeaturesFor](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/experiments/pagination/types/PaginationContentFeaturesFor.md): Experimental: resolves a pagination mode to the content features `<Paginate />` yields, the infinite set for `'infinite'` and the paged set otherwise.
- [PaginationLink](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/experiments/pagination/types/PaginationLink.md): Experimental: an entry in the numbered pagination links list, either a navigable numbered link or a placeholder for a gap, told apart by `isReal`.
- [PaginationLinks](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/experiments/pagination/types/PaginationLinks.md): Experimental: the reactive navigation links for a pagination state, with numbered links and gap placeholders plus `first`, `prev`, `next`, and `last` links for the active page.
- [PaginationLinks](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/spec/json-api-raw/types/PaginationLinks.md): A {json:api} `links` member that adds `first`, `last`, `prev`, and `next` pagination links to `self` and `related`.
- [PaginationLinksSubscription](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/experiments/pagination/types/PaginationLinksSubscription.md): Experimental: the framework-agnostic lifecycle core of a pagination links component such as `<EachLink />`, exposing the navigation links for a paged pagination state.
- [PaginationState](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/experiments/pagination/types/PaginationState.md): Experimental: one component's pagination state over a shared collection, tracking the active page and the loaded run and providing paged and infinite navigation.
- [PaginationStateFor](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/experiments/pagination/types/PaginationStateFor.md): Experimental: resolves a pagination mode to its state type, the infinite-mode state for `'infinite'` and the paged-mode state otherwise.
- [PaginationSubscription](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/experiments/pagination/types/PaginationSubscription.md): Experimental: the lifecycle core of `<Paginate />`, owning the initial request subscription and the component's pagination state.
- [ParamConfig](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/experiments/storage/types/ParamConfig.md): Experimental config passed to the `param` decorator that describes how a field is serialized to and parsed from a URL query parameter.
- [PendingPromise](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/reactive/types/PendingPromise.md): The `getPromiseState` state for a promise that has not yet settled, with `isPending` true and no value or reason.
- [PendingRequest](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/reactive/types/PendingRequest.md)
- [PersistedResourceKey](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/identifier/types/PersistedResourceKey.md): Resource key whose `id` is a known string, the form keys for server-loaded resources take.
- [PlaceholderPaginationLink](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/experiments/pagination/types/PlaceholderPaginationLink.md): Experimental: a non-navigable gap marker in numbered pagination links, standing in for a range of not-yet-loaded pages, usually shown as an ellipsis.
- [PolarisAliasField](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/schema/fields/types/PolarisAliasField.md): Field schema of kind `alias` for PolarisMode resources that exposes another field's cache value, including LinksMode relationships, under a new name.
- [PolarisModeFieldSchema](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/schema/fields/types/PolarisModeFieldSchema.md): Union of every field schema allowed on a PolarisMode resource schema, with relationships limited to their LinksMode forms.
- [PolarisResourceSchema](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/schema/fields/types/PolarisResourceSchema.md): Schema describing a PolarisMode resource type: its `@id` identity field, its fields, and the traits it implements.
- [PolarisTrait](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/schema/fields/types/PolarisTrait.md): A named, reusable set of PolarisMode fields that resource schemas compose in via their `traits`, often to model polymorphic capabilities.
- [PolicyConfig](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/store/types/PolicyConfig.md): Options for `DefaultCachePolicy`: soft and hard expiration times, header-based expiration constraints, and test-mode behavior.
- [PostQueryRequestOptions](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/request/types/PostQueryRequestOptions.md): Shape of the `POST` or `QUERY` request object that `postQuery` builders return, with a body and a required cache key since the url cannot serve as one.
- [PrimitiveValue](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/json/raw/types/PrimitiveValue.md): A JSON primitive (string, number, boolean, or `null`), the scalar case of the JSON `Value` type.
- [ProcessedExtension](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/reactive/types/ProcessedExtension.md): A registered schema extension normalized into its kind, name, and a map of its features keyed by property name.
- [PromiseState](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/reactive/types/PromiseState.md): The reactive pending, fulfilled, or rejected state of a promise, as returned by `getPromiseState`.
- [QueryOptions](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/types/QueryOptions.md): Legacy options for `store.query` and `store.queryRecord`, of which only `adapterOptions` is used, passed to the adapter rather than the server.
- [QueryParamsSerializationOptions](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/params/types/QueryParamsSerializationOptions.md): Options for query-string serialization, choosing how arrays are encoded: bracket, indices, repeat, or comma.
- [QueryParamsSource](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/params/types/QueryParamsSource.md): Query params to serialize into a request URL: a dictionary of serializable values with optional `include`, or a `URLSearchParams`.
- [QueryRequestOptions](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/request/types/QueryRequestOptions.md): Shape of the `GET` request object that `query` builders return for `store.request`, carrying the url, headers, and cache options.
- [QueryUrlOptions](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/utilities/types/QueryUrlOptions.md): Options passed to `buildBaseURL` to build the URL for querying a collection of one resource type.
- [ReactiveDataDocument](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/reactive/types/ReactiveDataDocument.md): The shape of a reactive response document whose `data` holds the request's primary records, with no `errors`.
- [ReactiveDocument](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/reactive/types/ReactiveDocument.md): The reactive wrapper around a request's response document that exposes its data or errors as live records, plus meta, links, and pagination helpers.
- [ReactiveErrorDocument](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/reactive/types/ReactiveErrorDocument.md): The shape of a reactive response document that carries `errors` and no primary `data`, such as the result of a failed request.
- [ReactiveResource](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/reactive/types/ReactiveResource.md): The rich, reactive record object that presents a resource's cached data through its `ResourceSchema`.
- [ReactiveResourceArray](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/reactive/types/ReactiveResourceArray.md): Native-Array-compatible reactive list of records backed by cache keys, returned for collection responses and underlying relationship and legacy record arrays.
- [ReactiveStorage](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/experiments/storage/types/ReactiveStorage.md): Experimental signal-backed wrapper around a `Storage` area that makes reads reactive and updates on changes from other tabs.
- [ReactiveStorageOptions](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/experiments/storage/types/ReactiveStorageOptions.md)
- [RealPaginationLink](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/experiments/pagination/types/RealPaginationLink.md): Experimental: a numbered page link with its page number, whether it is current, its distance from the active page, and `setActive` to load and show that page.
- [RecoveryFeatures](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/reactive/types/RecoveryFeatures.md): The online and visibility state plus a `retry` function that a request subscription exposes for recovering from a failed request.
- [RejectedPromise](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/reactive/types/RejectedPromise.md): The `getPromiseState` state for a promise that rejected, with `isError` true and the rejection `reason`.
- [RejectedRequest](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/reactive/types/RejectedRequest.md)
- [RelationalPaginationLink](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/experiments/pagination/types/RelationalPaginationLink.md): Experimental: a `first`, `prev`, `next`, or `last` link relative to the active page, with `setActive` to load it, and the only kind of link cursor-based pagination has.
- [Relationship](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/cache/relationship/types/Relationship.md): Cache-side state of a to-one or to-many relationship, with related resources as `ResourceKey`s, as returned by `cache.getRelationship`.
- [RelationshipDiff](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/cache/types/RelationshipDiff.md): Remote versus local state of one relationship, with additions, removals, and reordering for to-many, as returned by `cache.changedRelationships`.
- [RelationshipsSchema](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/schema/schema-service/types/RelationshipsSchema.md): Legacy relationship field definitions keyed by relationship name, returned by the deprecated `relationshipsDefinitionFor` schema hook.
- [RemotelyAccessibleIdentifier](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/request/types/RemotelyAccessibleIdentifier.md): A resource reference with a persisted `id` and `type` and an optional `lid`, which is enough for request builders to construct its url.
- [RemoteRelationshipOperation](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/graph/types/RemoteRelationshipOperation.md): Union of the Graph operations that update a relationship's remote (persisted) state.
- [RemoveDocumentOperation](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/cache/operations/types/RemoveDocumentOperation.md): Cache operation passed to `cache.patch` that removes a request's document from the cache.
- [RemoveFromDocumentOperation](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/cache/operations/types/RemoveFromDocumentOperation.md): Cache operation passed to `cache.patch` that removes resources from a request document's `data` or `included`.
- [RemoveFromResourceRelationshipMutation](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/cache/mutations/types/RemoveFromResourceRelationshipMutation.md): Cache mutation passed to `cache.mutate` that removes one or more resources from a relationship's local state.
- [RemoveFromResourceRelationshipOperation](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/cache/operations/types/RemoveFromResourceRelationshipOperation.md): Cache operation passed to `cache.patch` that removes resources from a relationship's remote state.
- [RemoveResourceOperation](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/cache/operations/types/RemoveResourceOperation.md): Cache operation passed to `cache.patch` that removes a resource as if deleted remotely, eliminating all references to it.
- [ReplaceRelatedRecordMutation](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/cache/mutations/types/ReplaceRelatedRecordMutation.md): Cache mutation passed to `cache.mutate` that sets a to-one relationship's local value, or swaps a single member of a to-many.
- [ReplaceRelatedRecordOperation](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/graph/types/ReplaceRelatedRecordOperation.md): Graph operation that sets a to-one relationship's value, or swaps a single member of a to-many.
- [ReplaceRelatedRecordsMutation](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/cache/mutations/types/ReplaceRelatedRecordsMutation.md): Cache mutation passed to `cache.mutate` that replaces or splices a to-many relationship's local members.
- [ReplaceRelatedRecordsOperation](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/graph/types/ReplaceRelatedRecordsOperation.md): Graph operation that replaces or splices the members of a to-many relationship.
- [RequestArgs](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/reactive/types/RequestArgs.md): The arguments of the `<Request />` component: the request or query to run, autorefresh options, and an optional store or subscription.
- [RequestContext](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/request/types/RequestContext.md): Object passed to each request handler with the immutable request, a request id, and methods for setting the response stream and the response.
- [RequestInfo](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/request/types/RequestInfo.md): Describes a request for `store.request` or `RequestManager.request`: native fetch options plus cache options, operation name, records, data, and the store.
- [RequestKey](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/identifier/types/RequestKey.md): Stable object with a unique `lid` that references a cached request document, letting that request's result be retrieved or replayed.
- [RequestLoadingState](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/reactive/types/RequestLoadingState.md): Reactive download progress for a request, such as bytes loaded and timing, built by lazily reading its response stream.
- [RequestProps](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/react/types/RequestProps.md): The props of the React `<Request />` component: the state components, the request or query to run, store, subscription, autorefresh options, and chrome.
- [RequestSignature](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/ember/types/RequestSignature.md): The Glint signature of the Ember `<Request />` component: its args and the blocks it yields to for each request state.
- [RequestState](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/reactive/types/RequestState.md): The reactive pending, fulfilled, rejected, or cancelled state of a request `Future`, as returned by `getRequestState`.
- [RequestStates](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/react/types/RequestStates.md): The components the React `<Request />` component renders for its idle, loading, cancelled, error, and content states.
- [RequestSubscription](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/reactive/types/RequestSubscription.md): Reactive subscription that monitors a request or query, tracking online, visibility and refresh state and handling autorefresh, reload and retry.
- [ResolvedPromise](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/reactive/types/ResolvedPromise.md): The `getPromiseState` state for a promise that resolved, with `isSuccess` true and the resolved `value`.
- [ResolvedRequest](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/reactive/types/ResolvedRequest.md)
- [ResourceBlob](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/cache/aliases/types/ResourceBlob.md): Opaque raw resource data whose format the Cache defines and from which the CacheKeyManager can derive a `ResourceKey`.
- [ResourceDataDocument](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/spec/document/types/ResourceDataDocument.md): Either a single-resource or a collection raw {json:api} data document, as stored in and returned by the cache.
- [ResourceDocument](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/spec/document/types/ResourceDocument.md): Any raw {json:api} document the cache stores and returns: meta-only, single-resource, collection, or error.
- [ResourceErrorDocument](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/spec/document/types/ResourceErrorDocument.md): A raw {json:api} document carrying an `errors` array for a failed request, as stored in and returned by the cache.
- [ResourceField](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/schema/fields/types/ResourceField.md): Field schema of kind `resource` for a reference to another resource; not yet implemented by `ReactiveResource`.
- [ResourceIdentifier](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/spec/json-api-raw/types/ResourceIdentifier.md): A reference to a resource by its WarpDrive-assigned `lid` alone, accepted by the cache once the resource's identity is known.
- [ResourceIdentifierObject](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/spec/json-api-raw/types/ResourceIdentifierObject.md): A reference to a resource in any form the cache accepts: `lid` only, `type` plus `id`, or a new resource's `type` plus `lid`.
- [ResourceKey](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/identifier/types/ResourceKey.md): Stable object with a unique `lid` plus `type` and `id` that uniquely references one resource's data in the cache, loaded or not.
- [ResourceMetaDocument](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/spec/document/types/ResourceMetaDocument.md): A raw {json:api} document carrying only `meta` and optional `links`, as returned by a request and inserted into the cache.
- [ResourceObject](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/spec/json-api-raw/types/ResourceObject.md): A raw {json:api} resource object, either for a persisted resource or for a new one created on the client.
- [ResourceOptions](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/schema-dsl/types/ResourceOptions.md): Options for the `Resource` class decorator that select legacy-mode compilation and name the primary key property when no property uses `@id`.
- [ResourceRelationship](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/cache/relationship/types/ResourceRelationship.md): Cache-side state of a to-one relationship, with `data` as a `ResourceKey` or `null` plus optional meta and links.
- [ResourceRelationshipsObject](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/spec/json-api-raw/types/ResourceRelationshipsObject.md): The `relationships` member of a {json:api} resource object: to-one or to-many relationship objects keyed by relationship name.
- [ResourceSchema](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/schema/fields/types/ResourceSchema.md): Union of the PolarisMode and LegacyMode schema definitions for a primary resource type, as registered with the schema service.
- [ResponseGenerator](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/holodeck/mock/types/ResponseGenerator.md): Function passed to the Holodeck mock helpers that builds the response body, called only when recording a fixture.
- [ResponseInfo](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/request/types/ResponseInfo.md): Immutable, JSON-serializable snapshot of a fetch `Response`'s headers, status, url, and type, usable in place of a `Response` in request results.
- [Scaffold](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/holodeck/mock/types/Scaffold.md): Full description of a mocked request, its request body to match, and its response status, headers, and body, as sent to the Holodeck server to record a fixture.
- [ScaffoldGenerator](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/holodeck/mock/types/ScaffoldGenerator.md): Function that builds a complete mock scaffold, accepted by `mock` in place of a `LazyScaffold`.
- [Schema](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/schema/fields/types/Schema.md): Union of resource and object schemas, covering any schema that can be registered with or returned by the schema service.
- [SchemaArrayField](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/schema/fields/types/SchemaArrayField.md): Field schema of kind `schema-array` for an array of objects described by an `ObjectSchema`, with options for member identity keys and polymorphism.
- [SchemaArrayOptions](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/schema-dsl/types/SchemaArrayOptions.md): Options for the `@schemaArray` decorator that choose the element object schema, polymorphic type resolution, element identity key, and default value.
- [SchemaObjectField](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/schema/fields/types/SchemaObjectField.md): Field schema of kind `schema-object` for a nested object whose shape is described by an `ObjectSchema`, with optional polymorphism.
- [SchemaObjectOptions](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/schema-dsl/types/SchemaObjectOptions.md): Options for the `@schemaObject` decorator that choose the embedded object schema, polymorphic type resolution, and default value.
- [SchemaService](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/schema/schema-service/types/SchemaService.md): The contract a store's schema service implements to answer which resource types, traits, fields, transformations, and derivations exist.
- [Serializable](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/params/types/Serializable.md): A query parameter value: one serializable primitive or an array of them.
- [SerializablePrimitive](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/params/types/SerializablePrimitive.md): A string, number, boolean, or `null` usable as a single query parameter value.
- [SharedPaginationContentFeatures](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/experiments/pagination/types/SharedPaginationContentFeatures.md): Experimental: the request status flags and controls, like `isRefreshing`, `refresh`, and `reload`, that `<Paginate />` yields to its content block in both modes.
- [SharedPaginationState](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/experiments/pagination/types/SharedPaginationState.md): Experimental: the pagination state members available in both paged and infinite mode, namely `totalPages` and `adoptPage`.
- [SignalHooks](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/configure/types/SignalHooks.md): The create, consume, notify, and memo hooks a framework or TC39 signals implementation supplies to `setupSignals` to make WarpDrive data reactive.
- [SignalIntegration](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/alien-signals/install/types/SignalIntegration.md): The hooks a signals implementation or framework integration registers with the alien-signals graph.
- [SignalNode](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/alien-signals/primitives/types/SignalNode.md): The opaque node returned by `createSignal`, which tracks the memos and watchers that consumed it.
- [SingleResourceDataDocument](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/spec/document/types/SingleResourceDataDocument.md): A raw {json:api} document whose `data` is a single resource or `null`, as returned by a request and inserted into the cache.
- [SingleResourceDocument](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/spec/json-api-raw/types/SingleResourceDocument.md): A raw {json:api} document whose `data` is one existing resource object, with optional `included`, `meta`, and `links`.
- [SingleResourceRelationship](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/spec/json-api-raw/types/SingleResourceRelationship.md): A to-one {json:api} relationship object whose `data` is a single resource identifier or `null`, with optional `meta` and `links`.
- [SortRelatedRecords](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/graph/types/SortRelatedRecords.md): Graph operation that reorders the members of a to-many relationship.
- [SortRelatedRecordsMutation](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/cache/mutations/types/SortRelatedRecordsMutation.md): Cache mutation passed to `cache.mutate` that reorders a to-many relationship's local members.
- [StableDocumentIdentifier](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/identifier/types/StableDocumentIdentifier.md): Deprecated alias for `RequestKey`, the stable cache reference to a request document.
- [StableExistingRecordIdentifier](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/identifier/types/StableExistingRecordIdentifier.md): Deprecated alias for `PersistedResourceKey`, a resource key whose `id` is known.
- [StableRecordIdentifier](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/identifier/types/StableRecordIdentifier.md): Deprecated alias for `ResourceKey`, the stable cache reference to a single resource.
- [StoreProviderProps](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/react/types/StoreProviderProps.md): The props of the React `<StoreProvider />` component: its children plus either a Store instance or a Store class to instantiate.
- [StoreRequestContext](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/StoreRequestContext.md): Object passed to each request handler with the immutable request, a request id, and methods for setting the response stream and the response.
- [StoreRequestInput](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/StoreRequestInput.md): The request object `store.request` accepts, either a full immutable request info or a looser form with plain `records` and `headers`.
- [StoreSetupOptions](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/StoreSetupOptions.md): Configures the cache, cache policy, request handlers, schemas, and schema extensions that `useRecommendedStore` wires into a Store class.
- [StringSatisfiesIncludes](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/record/types/StringSatisfiesIncludes.md): Type utility that checks a comma-separated `include` string contains only paths from an allowed union, resolving to `never` otherwise.
- [StructuredDataDocument](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/request/types/StructuredDataDocument.md): The `{ request, response, content }` object that a request's `Future` resolves with when the request succeeds.
- [StructuredDocument](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/request/types/StructuredDocument.md): Union of the success and error documents that a request's `Future` resolves or rejects with.
- [StructuredErrorDocument](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/request/types/StructuredErrorDocument.md): The Error a request's `Future` rejects with when the request fails, carrying the `request`, `response`, `error`, and any `content` received.
- [SubscriptionArgs](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/reactive/types/SubscriptionArgs.md): Options for a request subscription: the request or query to monitor and its autorefresh settings.
- [Trait](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/schema/fields/types/Trait.md): Union of the LegacyMode and PolarisMode trait definitions that can be registered with the schema service.
- [TraitOptions](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/schema-dsl/types/TraitOptions.md): Options for the `Trait` class decorator that select whether it compiles to a polaris-mode or a legacy-mode trait.
- [Transformation](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/reactive/types/Transformation.md): A registered converter between a field's raw cache value and the value exposed on the record, with optional default.
- [Transformation](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/schema/concepts/types/Transformation.md): A registered pair of `serialize` and `hydrate` functions that convert a field's raw cached value to and from the value exposed on a record.
- [TypedRecordInstance](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/record/types/TypedRecordInstance.md): Shape of a record type that declares its resource type via the `[Type]` symbol, letting WarpDrive APIs infer types for better type safety. TypedRecordInstance
- [TypeFromInstance](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/record/types/TypeFromInstance.md): Type utility giving a record type's `[Type]` resource type string, or `never` if it declares none.
- [TypeFromInstanceOrString](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/record/types/TypeFromInstanceOrString.md): Type utility giving a record type's `[Type]` resource type string, or `string` if it declares none.
- [UnknownOperation](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/graph/types/UnknownOperation.md): Placeholder Graph operation, with `op: 'never'`, for a relationship whose to-one or to-many kind is not yet known.
- [UpdateRecordUrlOptions](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/utilities/types/UpdateRecordUrlOptions.md): Options passed to `buildBaseURL` to build the URL for saving changes to an existing record by type and id.
- [UpdateRelationshipOperation](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/graph/types/UpdateRelationshipOperation.md): Graph operation that replaces a relationship's remote state with a raw JSON:API relationship object.
- [UpdateRequestOptions](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/request/types/UpdateRequestOptions.md): Shape of the `PATCH` or `PUT` request object that `updateRecord` builders return for `store.request`, identifying the resource being saved.
- [UpdateResourceFieldOperation](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/cache/operations/types/UpdateResourceFieldOperation.md): Cache operation passed to `cache.patch` that replaces the remote value of a single field on a persisted resource.
- [UpdateResourceOperation](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/cache/operations/types/UpdateResourceOperation.md): Cache operation passed to `cache.patch` that merges new remote state into a persisted resource.
- [UpdateResourceRelationshipOperation](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/cache/operations/types/UpdateResourceRelationshipOperation.md): Cache operation that replaces the remote state of one relationship on a persisted resource.
- [UrlOptions](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/utilities/types/UrlOptions.md): Any of the option shapes `buildBaseURL` accepts, one per request `op` plus a generic `resourcePath` form.
- [Validate](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/record/types/Validate.md): Type utility that checks a hand-written preview type `K` is a valid subset of the full type `T`, resolving to `K` if so and `never` otherwise.
- [Value](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/json/raw/types/Value.md): Any JSON-serializable value (primitive, array, or object), used for raw field and payload data throughout WarpDrive.
- [ValueTransition](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/experiments/storage/types/ValueTransition.md)
- [WarpDrive Contributor Skills](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/skills/contributors.md)
- [WarpDriveConfig](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/build-config/types/WarpDriveConfig.md): The options passed to `setConfig` or `babelPlugin` to control WarpDrive logging, deprecation code stripping, canary features, and optional features.
- [WithPartial](https://canary.warp-drive.io/pr-preview/pr-11291/api/@warp-drive/core/types/utils/types/WithPartial.md): Utility type that makes only the named properties of an object type optional.
